in_marathi.name: Vihvansh
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God of Prosperity
in_marathi.long_meaning: Vihvansh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Vihvansh is derived from the Sanskrit language, and it means 'God of Prosperity'. This name holds immense significance in Hindu mythology, where the god Vihvansh is believed to be the creator of the universe and the provider of all material and spiritual wealth.
